edition/year: ISO/IEC 25010:2023, Edition 2; quality-in-use content separated into ISO/IEC 25019:2023
scope: Defines the product-quality model for ICT and software products. The 2023 edition has nine top-level characteristics and adds safety, while renaming usability to interaction capability and portability to flexibility. Quality-in-use is no longer in 25010 and is addressed by 25019:2023.
overlap: Lawful explanatory pages expose the 2023 characteristic structure and edition changes, sufficient to draft a preliminary non-functional-requirements taxonomy. They do not provide the authoritative definitions and complete subcharacteristic relationships needed for contractual acceptance criteria.
recommendation: PURCHASE SECOND WAVE — acquire ISO/IEC 25010:2023 when converting architecture quality concerns into measurable software/platform requirements and acceptance criteria. Do not buy 25010:2011. Buy ISO/IEC 25019:2023 only if the project will formally specify operator/decision-maker quality-in-use outcomes; it is not automatically part of H3.
rationale: Important for platform quality attributes, but downstream of selecting stakeholders, concerns and views under 42010. For a safety-relevant SHM platform, the added 2023 safety characteristic makes the current edition materially preferable to the commonly cited 2011 model.
